limits: Author verification is not independent QA or publication verification.
Fresh Anaconda installation, cross-platform installation, browser Jupyter UI and socket kernel transport not tested.
No real task performance, population calibration, significant group differences or GPU benchmarks are claimed.
Holdout file is readable; freeze logging is pedagogical and is not access control or external preregistration.
Two records per entity may be dependent; no confidence intervals inferred from row count.
Regression is a bounded floating-point teaching implementation; extreme values or square underflow are rejected.
Build emitted Fontconfig cache permissions and kernel network-interface discovery warnings; artifacts were actually generated and checked.
